workItem: Implement SH-02.7 exact-SHA runtime recovery by re-driving only the canonical verified CI deploy-production job for the exact current-main SHA and independently verifying production identity, liveness and readiness.
workItemDE: SH-02.7 Exact-SHA Runtime Recovery implementieren, indem ausschließlich der kanonische verifizierte CI-Deploy-Production-Job für den exakten Current-Main-SHA erneut ausgeführt und Production-Identität, Liveness und Readiness unabhängig zurückgelesen werden.
priorityReason: OPS-08-B-SH-02 remains the highest executable OPS package until SH-02.11 is terminal; SH-02.7 is the next functional slice after SH-02.6.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
scopeNote: Materialize the exact-SHA recovery capability without creating a second deployment authority. The workflow reuses ci.yml/deploy-production and remains fail-closed unless CAPITAL_AI_ENABLE_EXACT_SHA_RECOVERY=true; Render credentials stay isolated in the existing production environment job.
activationBoundary: Activation remains HELD in self-healing-contract/1.0.0 and by default in the workflow. A separate current-main activation convergence is required after the competing Supervisor writer is terminal. Kill switch CAPITAL_AI_DISABLE_EXACT_SHA_RECOVERY=true always overrides activation.
correlationNote: Initial CI exposed a stale active OPS Roadmap baseline plus a shared Supervisor expectation. The stale Roadmap baseline is fixed here. The Supervisor overlap with open PR #1186 is avoided by reverting all shared Supervisor contract/test paths to CURRENT_MAIN and separating capability implementation from activation.
